headline: A 500 MW solar power plant with the participation of an Omani company is being built in Fergana
summary: A 500 MW solar photovoltaic plant will be built in Fergana region with $350 million of direct investment, involving the company O'mon. O'mon's Voltamp unit will also build a high-voltage transformer plant in Tashkent region.
why: Large-scale solar generation and grid equipment such as transformers are core parts of energy infrastructure investment, and foreign direct investment in them signals capital flows into power sector development.
original_headline: Farg‘onada O‘mon kompaniyasi ishtirokida 500 MVt quvvatli quyosh elektr stansiyasi quriladi
